name: Aes67StreamEndpointDescriptor
comment: Datatype of a Stream Registry entry. Fields are essentially the relevant fields of OcaMediaStreamEndpoint, plus a few added items.

properties.name: Addresses
properties.comment: List of transport addresses (IP address plus port number) of all redundant paths of the stream. Authoritative IP information for registry entries.

properties.name: AlignmentLevel
properties.comment: Alignment level of the stream endpoint. NaN if not known.

properties.name: AdaptationData
properties.comment: AES70-21 Adaptation-specific data. Aes67EndpointAdaptationData.IPParameters is not suited for this context and shall be ignored; required IP information is in Addresses.

properties.name: SDPString
properties.comment: SDP string that describes this Endpoint, if available. If this SDP string describes multiple streams, MediaIDType and MediaID shall identify the stream.

properties.name: MediaIDType
properties.comment: What kind of identifier MediaID is.

properties.name: MediaID
properties.comment: Identifier of the stream for the given Endpoint.

properties.name: SIPString
properties.comment: SIP string that identifies this Endpoint, if available.

properties.name: InfoSource
properties.comment: Identifier of source of data for this entry, if available.

properties.name: TimeStamp
properties.comment: Time this entry created or last updated.
